footer.line: Integrated Pastoral Management and Analytics System

hero.subhead: SIGAP turns your census, attendance and committees into population pyramids, spiritual life-cycle tracking and growth projections — with the same clarity for the local pastor, the district leader and national leadership.
hero.trust: Private access by invitation and authorized profile.

levels.nacionalDesc: A consolidated view of the whole country

rollup.caption: One data point, rolled all the way up
rollup.nacionalDesc: A read on the whole country

modules.text1: Census, families and each person's spiritual life cycle, from the day they join to the role they hold.
modules.text2: Population pyramid, growth projection and a health traffic-light — the same at the local, district and national level.
modules.text3: Evangelism, Youth Mission and the 10 committees, consolidated at every level.

plans.title: The same complete SIGAP, at whatever pace works for your congregation.
plans.subtext: No trimmed-down features or a "basic version" — the difference between plans is the commitment period, not what you can do with the system. Message us and we'll advise you on the exact price for your congregation's size.
plans.monthlySummary: To get started with no strings attached, and see the change from your very first month-end close.
plans.monthlyBenefit1: Full access to every module, with no features locked.
plans.monthlyBenefit2: Your congregation is up and running on SIGAP in days, not months.
plans.monthlyBenefit3: Adjust or cancel whenever you need to.
plans.annualSummary: For the congregation that has already decided SIGAP is how it works, all year round.
plans.annualBenefit1: Same full access, with a better total cost across the year.
plans.annualBenefit2: Ongoing support through every quarter of growth.
plans.annualBenefit3: Priority support and early access to new features.
plans.trust: We'll reply on WhatsApp with the price based on the number of congregations and districts you need to manage.

historico.titulo: Active congregations and MRR day by day
historico.tip: This history is captured automatically, once a day. Unlike the charts above (calculated from the registration date), this is a real snapshot saved every day -- but it only exists since this capture was activated.
historico.armando: This history is being built starting today. Come back in a few days to see the real trend.

simulador.titulo: How many new congregations do you need per month?
simulador.subtitulo: Adjust the number and watch the projection. Starts with the real average of the last 3 months.
simulador.inputLabel: New active congregations expected per month
simulador.nota: Simple projection: congregations active today + (new per month × months), multiplied by the current average revenue per congregation. Does not assume churn or price changes.

amigos.subtitulo: Separates what Ushers log from what the pastoral path manages.
amigos.sinDatos: No friends attendance data to show yet.
amigos.nota: Important: this attendance is a total by category; it does not identify which friend attended. To measure individual conversion, the friend would need to be registered as a person or linked to attendance individually.

feligresiaStats.bautizadosTip: Live total, right now. The quarterly Membership report instead shows a snapshot at quarter close -- they may not match if you're not in the current quarter.
feligresiaStats.reconciliadosTip: Inactive people who returned to Active status in the last 90 running days. This differs from the number you see in Membership → Quarterly report, which is limited to the exact calendar quarter -- they may not match.
feligresiaStats.ritmo3m: At the pace of the last 3 months ({{signo}}{{valor}}/month), in 12 months. Estimate with limited history.

vacio.titulo: Your panel is ready for data

evolucion.sinDatos: No activity records to chart here yet.

alertasPastorales.sinAlertas: No alerts for now. SIGAP reviews attendance trends and pastoral conditions from the census, such as pending families, baptism, individual absence, and committees with no members.
alertasPastorales.atenderTip: Closes the alert at once and saves an automatic follow-up (with no note of your own). To log the actual action you took, do it from Membership → Pastoral follow-up.

riesgoApartamiento.subtitulo: People with more than one sign of drifting away, before the 90 days of the pastoral alert are reached — to act early, not just react.
riesgoApartamiento.masConSenales: And {{cantidad}} more person/people with risk signals.
